input.sha256_scope: No image input. Every case is token lists, labelled text blocks, or block geometry written out in the capture tool; the expected file is both the input record and the expected record.

upstream.capture_method: TableStructureMetric was loaded from the pinned file with only its unused DetMetric import replaced, and executed; MarkdownConverter.convert, get_seg_flag, and merge_formula_and_number were imported from the pinned paddlex and executed.

limitations: The assembly handler map holds only the labels whose formatters this port implements; image, chart, formula, and seal handlers are artifact-blocked, and blocks with those labels are skipped exactly as an unknown label is.
The structure metric compares concatenated token strings, so two different token lists can compare equal; the concat_hides_a_difference case pins that hazard rather than repairing it.
get_seg_flag is exercised on two geometry cases, one per branch of the continuity decision; the ten-pixel tolerances are upstream's.
